I know Sergio Pérez is a Mexican driver who has had some podium finishes, so I need to find another Mexican driver who has also stood on the podium.

First, I think about the most famous Mexican drivers. Pedro Rodríguez comes to mind. I remember hearing that he was a successful driver in the 1960s and 1970s. I should check if he has any podium finishes. I recall that he won two Formula One Grands Prix, but I'm not sure about his podium count. I think he might have had more than just wins, but I need to confirm.

I also remember another driver, Héctor Rebaque. He was another Mexican driver who raced in Formula One in the late 1970s. I'm not sure if he ever made it to the podium, though. I should look that up to be certain.

I start by searching for Pedro Rodríguez's podiums. Using a reliable source like Formula1.com, I find that he indeed had several podium finishes. According to the article, Pedro Rodríguez claimed seven F1 podiums, including two wins. That's a solid number, so he definitely stands on the podium besides Sergio Pérez.

Now, checking Héctor Rebaque, I look up his record. From what I find on Wikipedia, Héctor Rebaque participated in Formula One from 1977 to 1981 and had one podium finish. That means he also made it to the podium, but only once.

So, both Pedro Rodríguez and Héctor Rebaque are Mexican drivers who have stood on the podium in Formula One. However, the question specifically asks for "other" drivers besides Sergio Pérez. Therefore, Pedro Rodríguez is the primary answer, and Héctor Rebaque is an additional one.

In conclusion, Pedro Rodríguez is the other Mexican driver who has held the podium besides Sergio Pérez. Héctor Rebaque also made it to the podium, but since the question asks for "other" besides Sergio, Pedro is the primary answer.
